readerCopy.body: A desire or refusal that was treated like a problem can become impossible to leave out of the decision about what comes next. When Lilith conjoins the North Node, autonomy and forward movement meet in the same choice, making an unconventional relationship, career move, boundary, lifestyle, or creative direction harder to keep separate from the plan. Wanting something does not automatically make it wise. Hiding the want makes honest planning much more difficult.
